user_saw: In Telegram partial streaming, a final answer with an explicit reply tag could appear unthreaded or reply to the wrong message.
summary: The fix compares the final answer’s requested reply target with the sent Telegram preview’s actual target and replaces the preview when they differ.
reasoning: PR #146361 added a comparison against the pre-recovery payload, which lets an already-present explicit target pass even when the preview has a different target. Its parent and the July 1 snapshot already reused text previews without checking the final target, and the July 1 docs already described explicit reply tags. The offline history search stopped at a missing parent, so I could not identify the introducing commit or verify that this combination ever worked on main.
